notes.title: Patch notes 14.4.2023
notes.content:
14.4.2023 Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Progress was previously disabled for some buildings due to multiplying with zero
[*] Political power is now accumulated 25% faster
[*] Liquid Waste accumulation tripled
[*] Farm is now using Gel Substance
[*] Fixed a coloring issue with a button in save panel
[*] Big Housing was left transparent after building Distribution Center or Security building
[*] "Road missing" was bloating the log due to triggering for each passenger
[*] "Biotech farmer" text was overflowing from it's text box
[*] Changed "workers" text in building pop up to the exact job names
[*] Management panel previously had passive policies as toggleable (which is how shouldn't be)
[*] Removed automation from some buildings
[/list]
